Tuesday Night Rubber Mallet

Bend, OR · NorthWest Crossing · Road

Tuesday Night Rubber Mallet is a road group ride in Bend, OR. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Jackson's Outpost at The Grove. About 34 miles, 19–20 mph average, 2–3 regroups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19–20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Night Rubber Mallet group ride

A spirited Tuesday road ride that rotates three routes. Not a no-drop ride, but the group regroups two or three times and teaches cooperative riding instead of a free-for-all. Riders should be self-sufficient. It is not affiliated with WebCyclery even though it used to start there.
